visual_logic.surface_detail: Deep 'Midnight Blue' skin with 'Copper-Orange' dappled spots along the lateral line. Skin appears dense and high-pressure resistant.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Emphasis on the massive, deep-bodied 'rotund' profile and the exceptionally long, equal-sized front and rear flippers.
visual_logic.environment: The 'Berlin-Ichthyosaur' sea environment; deep, clear water with long, horizontal 'god-rays' tracking side-to-side across the wide frame.
visual_logic.pose: A full-body horizontal profile view stretching completely from the left edge to the right edge of the frame. The massive, deeply rounded 'rotund' body is aligned flat in the lower half of the image, keeping the top half clear so a second species can be drawn or stacked directly above it for side-by-side length comparison. Its long, equal-sized flippers are swept slightly back along its side, and its elongated snout points straight forward.
